about: Adam D. Citron, a celebrated matrimonial attorney and partner at Davidoff Hutcher & Citron LLP, operates from the firm's offices in New York City and Westchester, New York. He skillfully navigates a wide array of family law matters for his clients, including:

Mr. Citron is dedicated to guiding his clients through these challenging times with compassion and understanding, aiming for swift resolutions through collaborative negotiations. His courtroom prowess, honed during his tenure as an Assistant District Attorney, allows him to fiercely advocate for his clients' interests. Discretion and confidentiality are vital to his practice, especially when representing high-profile individuals such as CEOs, celebrities, athletes and renowned professionals.

Valuing marital assets, from jewelry and fine art to real estate and cryptocurrency, is often crucial in divorce cases. Mr. Citron draws upon his extensive experience to address complex appraisal challenges, particularly when business interests are involved. His educational journey began at the University of Wisconsin – Madison, where he earned a Bachelor of Arts in political science and government in 2006. He went on to achieve his Juris Doctor cum laude from the University of Miami School of Law in 2009, gaining his New York license in 2010.

Before joining Davidoff Hutcher & Citron LLP in January 2013, Mr. Citron served as an Assistant District Attorney in Westchester County under the Hon. Janet DiFiore, contributing to the motions, appeals and special litigation division, and the grand jury and local court division. His experience includes arguing before the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of the State of New York and conducting numerous trials in state courts.
